notes.title: Patch 2.2.1 and the lookout for CM!
notes.notes:
Greetings Pilots!

In today’s update, we have three important pieces of news for you. Firstly, Daily Deal with a special price. Secondly, we come with the next portion of fixes, this time, as brought up earlier, for Heliborne Enhanced Edition. Thirdly, a recruitment announcement - we are looking for a worthy pilot to become our representative of PC and Xbox editions. Read more below.


DAILY DEAL
Steam supported us with a Daily Deal, which means we are featured on the main page for 24 hours. Heliborne Collection will be exposed to more Steam users, so we expect new players to join the game soon. Former community, your support to the new pilots is invaluable.
 
Be prepared to say hello! 

And if you have been following and waiting for a great deal to get the Heliborne Collection or you just want to convince your friends into playing with you, now’s a perfect time to do that. Heliborne Collection is currently 55% off! 

Have you not done this yet, JOIN OUR DISCORD by clicking below:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/ec49ecfc994a9d0ecb084b082aed373f3d4f609c.gif 


HELIBORNE PATCH 0.98.8a and HELIBORNE ENHANCED EDITION PATCH 2.2.1

As promised in our latest update, we are constantly working on new patches. This time we released a portion of fixes to Heliborne Enhanced Edition and a minor update to Heliborne.  Stay tuned for other patches in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/dcd2826055e2b15752f46819989ecd02a01f1c8a.jpg

Patch notes:

Heliborne patch 0.98.8a update:

 Helicopter names are now the same in both versions.


Heliborne Enhanced Edition patch 2.2.1:

 Changed how skins are implemented to make sure that everyone receives them all.
 Fixed an issue that could prevent the player from joining a PvE game.
 Fixed helmet skin display.
 Fixed folding chassis animation for prototype helicopters.
 Adjusted helicopters glossiness.


COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVE WANTED

There have been ups and downs throughout the over 4 years old development history. Heliborne quickly found its core audience, and the community has always appreciated the game. We moved Heliborne to a new engine and decided to bring it to console gamers. At the same time, we continued to improve the PC versions. We care a lot for the Heliborne IP, and therefore, we need more help for the recent and upcoming changes and challenges we are facing. Mindoug, the previous Community Manager and former JetCat Games member, will remain active on the Heliborne server with the original Heliborne version’s fans. However, we want to expand the team with another community role, who will manage both the PC community and the new console gamers joining soon.

We need:
- Xbox and PC gamer
- with fluency in English,
- appreciating and knowing well the Heliborne IP,
- with the community and management skills to process the feedback to developers;
- on top of all the above, the eagerness to stream would be an advantage.

If you meet the above expectations and you are ready manage the growing community, send your resume to contact@klabater.com following the below guideline:

[code]Subject: Applying for Heliborne Community Manager

In the email include: 
general information about yourself,
your nationality and place of residence,
Steam profile user name and link to your profile,
hours spent in Heliborne,
if you’re a member of the Discord server, let us know your nickname (nick#0000),
if you wrote a review for Heliborne, please attach it to the email (can be a screenshot),
let us know your feedback and your ideas for this role![/code]

Remuneration is to be negotiable. Any community management experience is welcome but not necessary. Please note that the minimum time spent in-game is 60hrs.


We hope this news finds you all well and that we will meet more and more of your expectations over time. 

Thank you for all your support and your long hours in the game!

Klabater Team

notes.title: Heliborne Collection update
notes.notes:
Greetings Pilots!

We have an important message and updates to pass on today. We’ll try to keep it short and not tl;dr. Briefly:

New launcher - new Steam product name - Heliborne patch - Discord updates - brief development status

NEW GAME LAUNCHER
In today’s patch, we introduced a new launcher. From now on, you can choose what Heliborne edition to play without switching between the branches. This will make the Heliborne game structure more transparent for the new customers, and we hope not much more complex for existing ones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/95067aa5f80ad01c26b324a50a549fc25c52cc4b.gif

NEW STEAM PRODUCT NAME
We implemented a new naming system - the main game on STEAM is now called Heliborne Collection. It includes Heliborne and Heliborne Enhanced Edition. Both editions contain all the DLCs published so far, and all the future content will be mirrored for both.
Worry not; each Heliborne version will be actively updated - today, you get the patch for Heliborne, and the Heliborne Enhanced Edition patch will follow soon.
There will be a need to download both games, so expect a 13-16 GB of download (depending on the OS) with this update. Sorry for the inconvenience.

HELIBORNE PATCH 0.98.8
New patch arrives in Heliborne:

 Fixed missing objectives on Tonkin map.
 Added new standard camos (14 new skins).
 Fixed the loading screen, causing the game to hard lock.
 Removed placeholder "campaign settings" button.
 Fixed Nguyen map - mission 3 now loads in the correct order.
 Updated copyrighted helicopter names with community suggestions.


DISCORD UPDATE
New discord server (servers structure) - a community update.

We have set up a new separate Discord server for Heliborne Enhanced Edition users to split the communities and avoid misunderstandings.
A new server link: https://discord.gg/kFzpMU8hRk. Feel invited. Please first read the rules.
The current Discord server: https://discord.gg/w7rbapJmXv remains active with mindoug’s supervision.


DEVELOPMENT BRIEF STATUS
Consoles and PC development:

We will keep improving Heliborne Enhanced Edition - next patch ETA end of March 2021, and keep fixing ongoing issues/bugs in Heliborne - patch today. Please use the current Discord channel actively to inform us about contemporary matters.
We also submitted Heliborne Enhanced Edition for console certification to Microsoft and expect the game to be commercially available still in Q1’2021. Additionally, we are now solving specific network-related issues on PlayStation. The date of the commercial launch for this platform is still TBA. 


Thank you for playing and following!

Klabater Team

notes.title: Enhanced Edition — When the next update will be released?
notes.notes:
Greeting pilots!

We haven't been releasing updates for a while, so let us tell you about what is happening with Heliborne development right now.

The team is currently working on fixes of the Enhanced Edition. We are planning to release the next update in mid-October. Although it should fix most of the known issues, we still want to take some time and hear your feedback before we would upload the Enhanced Edition back to the main branch. 

As of today, most of the visual issues are fixed. Right now, our priority is the UI. You gave us a lot of feedback in that regard, so we have completely rebuilt all the main screens, including squadron builder and battle rooms. Here are a few examples of how the squadron builder will look like:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/db4c72550d1dde74507dbd06a3a222f56b3fac94.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/c72bd9606dd9c3221c334748aa9d076125679e82.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/348aaf93a85d63b2cc86eba00c13af08e4113671.png

If you think we should improve anything here for better user experience, please share your ideas in the comments. 

Meanwhile, part of the team is working on the Xbox One version. We already have a stable version with good performance and full gamepad compatibility. This week we will focus on the network. We aim to finish all the critical parts and features of the Xbox build by the end of October and then proceed with testing. 

P.S. If you are new to Heliborne and wondering why the game looks different from the screenshots on the store page: there is an older version of the game on the main branch, the updated version—Enhanced Edition—has been temporarily transferred to beta versions. You can easily switch to it several simple steps:
[olist]
 Find Heliborne — Enhanced Edition in Steam Library.
 Right-click on it and choose Properties.
 Go to the Betas tab and select “enhanced_edition” from the dropdown menu.
 Wait until the update is downloaded.
[/olist]

Team Klabater

 Support amphibious landing of allied naval assault force,
 Defend against enemy amphibious landing.

 Defend against enemy tank attack.

 Search and eliminate enemy artillery batteries.

notes.title: One week after the Release (Update 0.87)
notes.notes:
Hey Pilots!

One week has passed since Heliborne has been officially released. And it’s been a really good time for the game: a lot of players having fun 24/7, dozens of new Heliborne streamers on Twitch and YouTube, media coverage worldwide. This is so great and exciting, especially for such a small team and project as ours! 

Even more exciting is how fast our community is growing. You guys are awesome! It’s a pleasure to see how active and dedicated you are. We’ve received tons of good ideas and advice how to make Heliborne great again. Will be done!

Heliborne community has also started to work on Heliborne wiki — feel free to use and expand it, any help is highly appreciated!

Meanwhile, Team JetCat has been working hard all the week to deliver you the first post-release update. In this update we have addressed the most pressing issues and also added new features:
	first batch of netcode improvements to provide better network synchronization;
	updated mechanics for AA missiles and flares;
	several new types of door gunners;
	mortar teams will now give a reward to players who deploy them.
The next update will be more focused on new content.

And the last thing for today. You probably remember how the Mighty Jingles helped us on the release? We decided to give him something special in return. Greet a new British camouflage for UH-1D with a logo of the overlord! It’s added into the progression as an additional camouflage which means everyone can get it. More neat stuff for the Jingles subscribers is coming, stay tuned!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/7eb470fc50f473da42eb530b0dddead8b4b53309.png
Update 0.87 changelog:
An interval between in-game background music tracks has been shortened.
New RPG/SMAW smoke trails.
The 'death cam' will show enemy helicopter more accurately.
First stage of Steam friends integration. Battles with your friends in them are now the highest ones in the battle list, your friends' names are green in-game now, also now you can check steam profiles of players from your last battle in Steam - View - Players.
Filters of a battle list will be active in-between the battles, battles are now showing sides correctly.
Cabin gunner in Mi-8MTV and Mi-8TV has been relegated to door gunners.
New door gunners: AGS-17 (grenade launcher) and NSV Utes (12,7mm) for Mi-8MTV, NSV Utes for Ka-27, paired M-60 for UH-1D.
Door gunners with M60 have been added to UH-1B.
Flares, if they blind a missile, will deflect a missile way farther (50 meters instead of 10) in direction of deployed flares.
Slight change to Flare chance to blind missiles on long distances
Air-to-air missile (R-60&AIM-9) mechanics have been changed: flare will be able to blind a missile only from medium range (about 500 meters), they won't misguide missiles from long range. AA missile itself, when blinded from long range (more than 400 meters), will not go off the course but will significantly lose maneuverability (4 times). It allows pilots to dodge a missile with active maneuver. When blinded from less than 400 meters, a missile will follow flares as before.
AA missiles (R60&AIM-9) now have bigger range and can be guided with maximum zoom.
Double spotting reward bug is fixed.
New ATGM launch sound
New helicopter crash sound
1 second delay between ATGM launches
3rd and 4th gen ATGM maneuverability after 2 sec of flight is reduced
Marker appearance mechanics are changed: markers will appear on a visibility range, hovering helis will be more visible now.
Infantry resupply mechanics are now changed: soldier will be occupying all free seats (they didn't use seats of deployed special troops before), double limit for special troops is removed.
MANPADs on 1st&2nd gens now have less fatal and slower missile. 3rd&4th gens are unchanged
Explosion calculations for AA and MANPAD missiles has been changed: max damage is the same, but will be decreasing to the border of explosion less than before.
Now successful mortars strikes will give an award to the transport heli pilot who deployed them.
Reward for destroying enemy mortars and special badge for destroying mortars in one battle.
Fixed bug with some Throttle devices in advanced control. Now collective won't jump to 0 when throttle is moved into minimum position.
Various small bugfixing
First batch of netcode improvements, should be less network synchronization issues.
ATGM netcode fixes, which should reduce the number of false hits.
EU-2 and US CENTRAL servers have been removed from servers list. Two others that has been left, more powerful ones, are located at the same data-centers.
The Mighty Jingles camouflage has been added to UH-1D.

Team JetCat

notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/22cdae31f2107c86b021ac5d42c9674c25fc1af4.jpg
Hey, Pilots!
This is happening — Heliborne has just been fully released!

First of all, we want to thank everyone who supported us along the way. We have managed to build a small, but very close and active community. You guys helped us with a lot of things which would be impossible without you, including almost all the localizations and voice acting for the historical campaigns. As for the tiny team of four, it’s vitally important to have those who will give you a hand when needed. And you even did not ask for anything in return. 

THANK YOU! YOU ARE AWESOME, AND WE LOVE ALL OF YOU!

As we announced before, we have a special gift for everyone who bought the game in Early Access. And we wanted it to be so special that we haven’t finished it yet, being insanely busy with the release version of the game itself. However, we believe it’s worth waiting. So thanks again, guys, this time for your patience!

Next, let’s talk about the game. Heliborne has been in the Early Access for a year and a half, since February 2016. Here’s a short list (ok, not so short) of what has been done:
20 new helicopters. Now Heliborne features 50 different birds, our plan is to significantly expand the hangar after the release.
3 new maps: Kosovo (25 sq. km), Khost Region (64 sq. km), and a huge and detailed training polygon where you can test helicopters before battles (you will be able to do more there, but let it be our small secret for now). Current map roster includes 6 maps — 5 combat maps and the polygon.
Night map. The first one with lights off is Kosovo. More on the way.
Squadron system. It’s been designed to add more tactics to battles. Very similar to a deck system in card collectible games.
Progression system and Research tree. We designed this research system to be a learning experience, not a grinding one, and plan to keep it this way.
Frontline PvP mode. More tactical evolution of Domination mode with plenty of ground vehicles.
PvE sandbox co-op mode. Also playable in solo.
Two historical campaigns: Easter Offensive in Vietnam (1972) and Operation Magistral in Afghanistan (1987–1988). Co-op play is planned for the post-release period.
Offline mode. For those who can’t or don’t want to play online. Unlocked squadron builder is coming soon.
Customization and cosmetic items. Dozens of helicopter camouflages, helmet paint schemes, and helmet patches.
Private profiles.
Rank & Awards system.
Modular damage system.
Detailed tactical map.
Improved flight model.
Advanced control scheme.
Gamepads/Joysticks/HOTAS support.
New types of deployable special soldiers: SMAW/RPG and mortars. 
Soundtrack.
Steam Trading Cards together with badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons.
New localizations.
A long list of less visible changes we don’t want you to bore with.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/3c8e2386001a73b83748b78fe4a217c0fb7e1af4.jpg
For those who would like to additionally support further Heliborne development, we’ve added several cosmetic DLC packs with thematic camouflages (4-7 in each). However, it’s totally up to you: players can still unlock plenty of other additional camouflages free of charge, and we’ll be adding more of them!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1eac2ae26dc8d18c8e9ff5dc5f4a150c90e63e20.jpg
The most important question is “What’s next.” Although the full release is an important milestone for the Team, we are too ambitious to finish the development at this point. We have plenty of ideas, and the release will hopefully give us necessary resources to implement them. With that number of pilots playing Heliborne lately, it’s rather a plan than a hope. 

We want to give you some details about what to expect in upcoming updates:
PvE improvements: new objective types like covert infiltration, search and rescue, cargo supply, PvE scenarios like defend the position, support the attack, and others
more PvP game modes
carryable cargo for heavy lift helicopters
new options for troop deployment (including fast-roping)
new types of weapons and equipment (radars, more ATGM specifics, etc.)
naval map, naval gameplay, naval helicopter and naval weapons
AI-helicopter for PvE
gameplay tutorial
co-op mode for historical campaigns
in-battle lobby with a possibility to invite friends
VoIP-chat
a special gift for early supporters
more music to listen to in battles
updated sound effects
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Id0ZiyTAOYA
Special thanks to The Mighty Jingles who has made a Heliborne review just before the release. The game has never seen such a huge amount of players online as yesterday. Honestly, this is the best possible present we could get for the release.

Apart from that, we also want to thank all the other YouTubers/streamers. Thanks to them we have been able to spread the word about Heliborne even with zero marketing budget. BaronVonGamez, MagzTV, PhlyDaily, Raptor, TheDevildogGamer, and many others gave us a push when we entered the Early Access, just as The Mighty Jingles did on the full release. Don’t know if we could have made it without their help (probably not).

Version 0.86 changelog:
Night version of the Kosovo map. Only PvP at the moment, but PvE version will also be added soon. Be warned: the visibility here is much lower than on its day-time counterpart.
5 new helicopters in the research tree: AH-6, MH-6, Ka-26, Ka-27, and Ka-60.
The first version of historical missions. They are divided into two campaigns, which will be improved and expanded later.
New helicopter camouflages, around 40 variations. Can be unlocked for progression points.
Several cosmetic DLC packs with nearly 40 thematic helicopter camouflages. Purchasable via Steam.
MH-60L/AH-60L has received 4 soldiers.
Romanian IAR-330L has been moved to the Soviet side.
ATGM improvement: a missile loses direction when a player switches to another weapon.
Mortar troops improvement: more powerful mortar shell (close to rockets damage-wise) and increased ammo.
Filters for the list of battles.
Tonkin map: the map borders have been expanded.
"Power shield" on bases against spawn killing has been removed from PvE.
The reward for finishing PvP battles (both with victory and defeat) has been increased significantly.
A reward for completing objectives to the whole team has been added to PvE. The higher is the difficulty, the more points you get.
Ground vehicles on Nguyen map now are more vulnerable to miniguns.
Background in-battle music has been added.
Players limit has been decreased for PvP-mode on two maps: Tonkin — 5v5, Badakhshan — 6v6.
Helicopters' textures have been updated.

Faithfully yours,
Team JetCat

notes.title: Heliborne 0.73 — Progression System (pre-release update)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/cee2a16bc49ab20dc7aa9a5b467437dccdbf4b56.jpg
Greetings Pilots! Heliborne is getting closer to the release, the Date will be announced very soon. Almost everything that we’ve promised to add during the Early Access stage has been implemented already. Just a few things will be left after the update 0.73, like a single player campaign, soundtrack and updated sounds, several new helicopters, and some other changes. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/efb1e774caa0423ab7448acb02b079f80db5b03e.jpg
The Update 0.73 introduces a new game element, a very important one —  Progression System. From now on most of the helicopters will be locked at the beginning. You’ll need to play and earn progression points to unlock helicopters and new modification.

We’ve been testing the progression system a lot to be both challenging and fun. Although you don’t have everything on a plate from the very start, you should be able to unlock something new literally after every battle. We really hope it will bring more players to battles and make you Heliborne experience more satisfying.

Please let us know what you think about it and how do you find the speed and difficulty of the progression: fast/easy, slow/difficult, or just perfect.

What about experience points (=military ranks) you have already earned, you would ask? They will be transformed into progression points! It means that those of you who’ve been playing Heliborne recently will receive a certain amount of points in exchange for military rank. You will be able to spend them right away.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1eb693a9d2d7da243e3a04b951cacb982e7a6c93.jpg
Many players asked whether it is possible to play Heliborne without an internet connection. Now it is — the update 0.73 features the Offline Mode! Single player campaign, when released, will be available in Offline Mode as well.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/637250fc8d64319cf9f0664095e5109f8590ef33.jpg
Apart from that, we’ve introduced first 24 camouflages (more will be added on release), kill assist, new hangar music (thanks to NicerDicer!), in-lobby battle timer, bonuses for finishing battles, and more.

0.73 Changelog:

progression system
first 24 camouflages added to progression (more on release)
squadron repair bonus: you will get faster repair time with squadron which does not utilize more than half of available points
offline start - you can start the game without an internet connection
ATGM launch warning - you will have a warning now when ATGM is launched in your direction, also there is possibility to have additional info about where is ATGM coming from, depends if it shot from forward, side or back
top ATGM max speed is reduced a bit
now you need soldiers and vehicles inside landing zone give 50% of capture points for top team point bar, instead of 100% given if both are present
ATGM bug where it exploded on launch was fixed
mortar stuck inside landing zone bug fixed
helicopter tilt and strafe when rotating in hover changed - should make less movement
RPG accuracy on ground targets significantly improved
RPG accuracy on air targets reduced
rifleman accuracy reduced
using spotting you can now mark soldiers for friendly vehicles to shoot from bigger distances
using spotting you can now mark soldiers for friendly door gunners to shoot from bigger distances
squadrons now won't be destroyed when helicopter squad prices are changed, but they will be marked as an invalid squadron and you can fix them
Mi-24P main gun and AH-1G Vulcan gun now have recoil, also Mi-24P main gun now does not have forced burst
all guns and bullets were changed according to feedback from new damage system
some rockets were changed according to feedback from module damage system
tail module now takes more damage before being "critted" comparing to other models
AA fire should be a bit more accurate and a bit more powerful according to feedback from module damage system
some reward point values are changed for PvP and Coop
you now will receive a significant reward for a win or defeat in PvP battles, win in Coop battles and first win of the day in any type of battle
rank point criteria are changed, generally, ranks are now harder to obtain than before, but not very hard
in the coop, neutral LZ's should not be suddenly captured by enemies if a player is in close vicinity to it
added point reward for kill assist
stealing "spot" is now impossible if you "spot" enemies which are currently are under "spot" effect from someone else - you will just prolong the spot effect, you need to "spot" enemies which are not spotted atm to get spotting reward
lobby battle UI now shows timer till the end of a battle
heat seeking missiles now have smaller than before (~45% smaller, but still pretty wide, locking sector)
UI changes
new hangar/menu melody - thanks to NicerDicer!

Team JetCat

Cosmetic itemshttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/7352b7aa192050f8dd7e95635f4b3829ccd8bc67.jpg

Firing range maphttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/51069ee7dc98f981013a638f95680919f2fca147.jpg
Highly and precisely detailed map of real military aviation polygon — 344th Tactical Deployment Center in Torzhok. It was modelled according to satellite data, photos and videos.
You can start practice flight straight from the hangar or squadrons menu. Hangar is a part of polygon map, so the flight would start almost immediately and from the same location.
Training mission is in the development, and would take place on the same map. We would continue improving the map, adding more training possibilities and even special game mode.

Apart from that we added:
New helicopters, including MD-500, Ka-226, HH-53.Gamepad/joystick/HOTAS support. Popular devices received ready-to-go control configurations, but you can connect literally any device (up to 4 simultaneously).  Advanced control scheme. For those who want to receive highest possible control under helicopter.Steam Trading Cards. Six cards featuring legendary helicopters. Badges, profile backgrounds, emoticons. Collect trading cards, create badges and get Heliborne emoticons together with backgrounds to customize your Steam profile.New localizations. Currently Heliborne supports English, Russian, German, French, Polish, Portuguese-Brazil, and Danish languages.

Part of them will be implemented within Early Access, the other part — in release version of the game.

Historical campaignshttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/de6b2332b008cd8e2bccea0620e9a483bd39d5d6.jpg

Experimental Night Mode. Night version of one of the maps is almost ready! 
Multiplayer mode improvements.

Modular damage system.
New helicopters.

Steam Workshop support. Selected user-created content will be added to the game if approved by Team JetCat.

In-game VoIP-chat (based on Discord SDK).
Unique gifts to everyone who has supported us during Early Access!

 2 new sandbox missions on maps of generation 1 and generation 3.
 Several new types of sandbox objectives.

 2 new types of enemy infantry for sandbox missions have been added.
 The UH-60L helicopter has been split into 2 separate helicopter models - MH-60L and UH-60A. The first model, the MH-60L, is an armed version with 4 armament variants without troop-carrying capability. This moel starts with the DAP model, which is a previously non-existent version, followed by 3 AH-60L variants we already had. This model has been given forward facing miniguns for all armament options. The second model is a pure transport UH-60A with 3 door gunner armament options.
 Mi-8MTV has been given an additional door gunner in the back part of the cargo hold. New first armament option is now armed only with 2 rocket launchers and cockpit gun. Third armament option has two automatic grenade launchers instead of 2 rocket pods.
 Both of the grenade launchers, 30mm one for RU side and 40mm one for US side have been changed: ammo flight trajectory is now shallower and the weapon is easier to aim and operate.
 UH-1Y has been given an additional armament option with 2 rocket pods on each side.
 MH-60S now has addtional forward pointing miniguns for all armament options. There is also an additional armament option with 2 rocket pods on each side.
 Added a door gunner on the Mi-8T.
 Mi-8AMTSH has been given an additional rear door gunner. And two new armament options - first with only 2 gunpods and fourth heavily armed option. Also AMTSH gunner from 2nd to 4th armament options are 12.7mm machinegunners now.
 Squadron prices for all helicopters mentioned above rescaled, some changes to other helicopter prices.
 Heat seeker missile locking time parameters and locking sector parameters have been rescaled a bit, it should take less time to aquire a lock for both smaller and larger missiles.
 Fixed a bug with the frontline game mode where you could not win despite your armor capturing enemy stronghold.
 Fixed a bug in the advanced control scheme related to inability to use mouse to look around.
 Added setting to change mouse role in advanced control scheme.
 Added a setting to enable/disable helicopter names near helicopter type icons in combat HUD.
 Several helicopter texture fixes have been applied.


Team JetCat

Pilots! It's finally here! The ability for you to play Heliborne in Single-Player and CO-OP in pure PVE has finally arrived! It's taken us a long time to get here and for that, we're sorry, but we think this first step in to SP/COOP is a good one and we hope you agree.

We've also added the ability to test and fly any helicopter in the game from the squadron tab or the hangar tab. This will take you to the new training map that will allow you the chance to experiment with all of our helos before heading in to MP-PVP.

We're pretty proud of this update, and we hope you are as well!
-Rayne
Team JetCat

Version 0.5

Two new singleplayer/cooperative sandbox missions have been added. Right now both of these missions are based on the frontline scenario and have up to 9 different types of tasks that can be issued while playing. We are very much looking for feedback with these missions and we are planning to add new types of tasks in next several weeks. (Ex: rescue and evacuation, infiltration, covert action, etc). Also we want to add one or two new types of scenarios for sandbox missions - for example counter-insurgency scenario and attack scenario. But that depends on your feedback and on how it aligns with our release plans (we are not currently planning to add all of our sandbox singleplayer content before release)http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9299459090b43d733e5dc9411cc7e42370f2f16d.png

Training flight mode added - You can try out helicopters from the Hangar tab, and the squadron tab, without joining a battle. The Minimap will show you the location of the shooting range. This ranges has some targets, and is a “free fire” area.

The Ka-226 russian light multirole helicopter has been added, and has been placed in recon the role at tier 4. This helicopter does not have any armament outside artillery aim, however, it does have door gunners which work only when there are at least 2 soldiers on boardhttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/2ce59d8458bb547353952412b486a28e5b88a8ee.png

The HH-53 US heavy transport has been added to tiers 2, 3, and 4. The HH-53 Does not have any armament besides door gunners, which come in 2 armament variants - miniguns and .50 cal’shttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/99e42d4901977f76e5102c4ac3a14bab3354bf4b.jpg

The ACH-47 has been made into a gunship. The “Guns A Go Go” version of the helicopter is intended to clear and secure Landing Zones, the amount of troopers inside has been lowered to 10 men and 2 additional door gunners have been added.

The AH-1J has been moved to generation 3, squadron prices have changed for this helicopter

Squadron prices slightly (no big changes) adjusted for 10-15 helicopter variants (mostly intermediate variants to make them more useful)

Several flight parameters have been changed or updated, this mostly affects light helicopters, making them more agile and responsive.

The 20mm gun on H-34, ACH-47, IAR 330L and UH-1Y split into the M24 and GIAT M621 variants, each with different characteristics.

The NS-23KM (Mi-2 gun) has been given better explosive rounds.

All 30mm and 20mm explosive rounds have had their area of effect slightly rescaled to make more sense.

The GSH-2-30K has been given a burst cooldown if more than 50 rounds are fired repeatedly.

Look Around (right mouse button by default) mechanics have changed.When pressing the look around mode button (default right mouse button) the players helicopter no longer maintains the last ordered course. Instead, the helicopter will maintain a course that will be between current and last ordered course. Practically this means that to circle around some positions, you now simply need to press Look Around for a few moments every several seconds. Greetings pilots! Time for another Patch. Today we are pushing out version 0.48 with a new experimental game mode, some quality of life changes, and several balance and gameplay tweaks. Take a look!
-Rayne

A new Experimental Frontline game mode has been added for the following 3 maps - Nguyen, Khost, and Kosovo. Notes

 RPG soldier cost is down to 5 points
 MANPAD cost is up to 15 points
 MANPAD soldiers are now able to launch 3 missiles, up from 2
 All MANPAD-launched missiles now have a misfire chance of 40% on  Generation 1, 30% on Generation 2, 20% on Generation 3, 10% on Generation 4
 All air launched IR missiles now have similar misfire chance of 20%/15%/10%/5% per Generation 1/2/3/4
 IRCM miss chances are increased to 60% for missiles on distances greater then 250 meters and 82% on 250 meters and less
 Several changes to helicopter costs for squadrons have been made. The top armament variant costs are the same, baring the AH-1J Sidewinder variant - its cost has been increased.  Awards tab in Career now shows all possible awards, not only ones you have at the moment

 Awards given for air to air kills (the Air combat master series) now give additional points upon being earned. As normal, the points for the awards themselves assist with rank progression. 
 Awards for air kills now require more kills (15 20 30)
 All officer rank requirements have been increased by 30%.
 Several helicopter’s landing collider modules have been fixed to prevent sudden explosion upon landing.
 Modern high-caliber rockets (130mm S-13 and 127mm Zuni) damage output has been increased. Now they can destroy light armored vehicle with one direct hit
 “V-sync for hangar” option has been added to Graphic settings
 Several helicopter’s flight parameters have been adjusted (Mi-2 and Ka-25 made slightly more agile, AH-1Z loses more altitude when in a dive)
 Spotting targets with recon helicopter now marks them for 50 seconds



0.48.1

Resupply on Landing Zones in Experimental mode now does not work on IR missiles
Flares now bounce from the ground and other hard surfaces

notes.title: Heliborne version 0.47 "Foundation" is live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/8eeb3ac49d8ded9149a7d9c26f703c4597941e38.png


Greetings Pilots! It's been a while, and I do apologize for that, but we think it will have been worth the wait. With this update, we finally have the foundations in place for the sprint to release. With a new awards system, the backbone for future SP and CO-OP content, major backend changes and code updates, a lot of fixes and more. 

 Server Changes 
Pilots, just a quick note that Heliborne is operating using a new Data Layer with this update. Unfortunately this has also caused several issues with some of our Azure based servers. What this means, is that we are prepairing a new server pack for you to play on, that should help with performance and connection issues.

However, there's one major change here, and that revolves around us having to shut down our current SEA server as we look for a better alternative for our SEA players. We're hoping the new data layer and updates to the server backend will give our SEA players a good experience on the EU and US servers until we can get a replacement SEA server operational. Again, this is not a permanent change.

We apologize for the inconvenience. -Rayne

New Aircraft
*The MD-500 has been added to the vehicle lineup. This Helicopter has been placed at Tiers 2 and 3.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9e48e49bce6640c9546226e9e95cd169c435ed0f.jpg


New Features
- Personal player profiles have been added. These profiles are shown upon player kill, as well as in the new Career tab.
- Rewards for effective actions in combat have been added. There are a total of 28 awards in this update.
- Rank progression has been added and is based on rewards gained.
- Player awards can be placed in a player's profile.
- The first batch of steam cosmetic items has been added, this includes a few helmets and patches.
- Helmets can be shown in a player's profile.
- Cosmetic items are awarded at the end of the match.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/167a69650a70fac9e2a50616c074188c99d7ba13.png


Bug Fixes and Changes
- Added keybind to trigger gun reload manually
- A special sound when gun reload is finished has been added
- Fixed a crucial bug in gun reloading, encounters with enemy guns may become deadlier with this patch
- Fixed precision bug in stationary and moving ground AA guns - they should become much more accurate now.
- Ground AA time before maximum precision is increased and damage output is lowered - to compensate giant increase in AA gun precision
- "enemy lock" has been added, a locked enemy is marked with ">" " enemy name <"
- Enemy lock is done automatically when targetting enemy in sight
- Keybind to trigger a manual enemy lock has been added and is toggleable (by default - E, works only in flight)
- Locking on an enemy now assists with gun shooting - this is nothing heavy, just a small aim assist that help with adjusting aim distance to that enemy - it should be easier to shoot at locked enemies than an enemy without lock.
- All ATGM's angle speed is decreased
- ATGM additional vision distance is now slightly smaller
- Taking hits while in ATGM aiming mode now "shakes" helicopter
- Mortar team ammo increased to 30 rounds
- Recon helicopter "spot" ability is now shown in the UI
- "spot" ability now spots targets for longer period of time
- "spot" ability now informs all friendlies on the map

Greetings pilots! It's been a wait,and for that, we'd like to apologize. However, I'd like to think the wait was well worth it. Welcome to version 0.46.1!

Controls
-Support for all major gamepads has been added. This includes PS4, XBOX One and Steam Gamepads. Settings can be changed via new settings tab.

-Support for Joysticks and HOTAS set ups has been added. Kebybinding and calibration settings can be accessed via a new settings tab.

Pilots, please keep in mind this is a first pass for these new controls and there may be issues. Also, default keybinds may be wrong. Please give us feedback.

Please note that custom settings will be discarded and you will need to setup your own custom controls again.

-Added new control scheme. There is now a  simple and advanced mode.

UI
-Control UI has been reworked.
-Settings UI while in the hangar has been reworked.
-A slider to control hangar music has been added

Gameplay and Balance
-Added ballistics pass to all weapons. Bullets now loose height and velocity over distance.
-Travel distance for larger caliber weapon has been increased.
-Several Weapon sounds have been changed
-All weapons now have a maximum amount of ammunition as well as a reload timer after all ammunition has been spent.
-The 2A42 weapon system is now 9 rounds per second instead of 18. Overall damage output is roughly the same.
-GSh-2-30K weapon system is now firing at 30 rounds per second.
-Gun aim has been reworked.
-"Crosshair Jumping" has been fixed.
-Ground vehicles now have front, side, back, and top armor values. Each vehicle has its own independent parameters. Tanks are now very heavily armored compared to IFV's and APC's.
-All bullets now have armor penetration values based on caliber.

As a result of the above changes, it is now no longer possible to damage a tank with 7.62 or 12.7mm weapon systems. Causing damage from the sides, rear, or top is now possible with larger caliber weapons but the damage will still be reduced due to heavy armor.

-AA Gun precision has been slightly increased
-Helicopters with optical systems now have a turret "precision mode" - This is toggalable from cockpit view with Keybind "F" by default.
-Current weapon is now shown on HUD.
-Current and Maximum zoom for cockpit view and ATGM view is now shown on HUD.
-Minor changes in flight parameters for almost all helicopters.
-Changes in audio volume and sound effects when in cockpit modes.

Heliborne is now 64bit enabled!
Steam will automatically download the 64bit version of Heliborne. This should happen with all future updates.

Thanks pilots! We hope you enjoy this update! -Rayne

Greetings pilots! It's time to discuss the upcoming version update. Heliborne version 0.46, which we're calling "Elevation" as we truly believe we are elevating the game to a new level. Though, this update also provides something of a foundation for future progress and updates as we move forward toward release. This article will go over all the major changes as well as list the preliminary patch notes for you. So, let's get started as usual shall we?


Unity Version 5.5.X
The first big thing of note is our move from Unity 4.X to Unity 5.X. Specifically, we are now on Unity version 5.5.0f3. Your first question no doubt is, "Why does this matter?" The answer to that is simply, it just does. It matters a lot. However the much longer winded explanation follows with the help of Unity's own version 5 website. I'll post a link here: https://unity3d.com/unity/whats-new/unity-5.0

For those not wanting to head to the link, here's Unity's own words for why version 5.0 is better.


The Physically-based Standard Shader to make your materials look consistent in any lighting environment, cross platform.
Real-time Global Illumination, built on Geomerics Enlighten technology.
The Audio Mixer, to massively improve audio in your game.
HDR Reflection Probes to enhance visual fidelity.
PhysX 3.3 to bring massive performance improvements to 3D physics.
Major updates to the animation system.
WebGL preview.


The above being just the start, or the tip of the iceberg so to speak. Here's a nice Unity version 5.0 Trailer for you to watch as well, which should help show off "Some" of the goodness.

*As a note, I think this trailer is amazing.*

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJ6Mkx1KEns

Moving on!

The new Stuff
A great deal has changed when you log in to the game now. Firstly, we have an entirely new Main Scene and Squadron Construction update for you to enjoy. This means a brand new map built entirely for the main hangar and squadron view scenes. One that you'll be able to fly on soon. As to what these new scenes and UI updates look like, here's a quick video showing them off,

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0CgqmsVCrw

As you can see, the Squadron Overview and construction system has been entirely remade. We're hoping this version is far more intuitive to use. The hangar scene has been redone as well. All of this, as I said, built on a brand new map that we'll be using for training missions in the future and maybe something else special you've all been asking for? :)

The Prelim Patch Notes
Here's a quick look at the preliminary patch notes for Version 0.46,

Moved the project from Unity Version 4.x to Unity Version 5.x. This means a lot of behind the scenes changes that will yield a great deal in the future for Heliborne as a whole.
Major changes to internal map building scheme. This has changed and optimized map workflow for creation and fix implementation.
Changes and updates to shaders and visual effects system.
New Hangar scene introduced.
New Main Scene and Squadron Overview
Squadron Constructor rework
UI Rework
Added new Afghanistan, Khost province, map. This map is for Tier 3.
Increased bullet lifetime by 30%
Decreased unguided rocket drop height after initial engine burst.


That's it for this one folks, stay tuned for more! We've got a lot more coming.
-Rayne

notes.title: Heliborne 0.45 "Synergy" Update is Live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png

1. Mortar Troops
- 2 man mortar squad with 20 mines
- costs 8 points per squad
- can be deployed anywhere on the map
- has firing range of 300 - 3000 meters, radio contact range of 5000 meters
- has proper mine travel time - do not expect mines to be fast
- receives targetting from any recon helicopter with "Mortar Observer"
- one recon helicopter can control up to 6 mortar teams at once

2. AA changes
- all AA now significantly more accurate
- it tries to predict your flying pattern
- the more you are in its sights - the more accurate it becomes, it takes ~20 seconds to reach maximum accuracy
- spotting formula introduced: the smaller your helicopter is and the lower you fly - the harder it is for AA to spot you
- with the new spotting formula you can sneak around AA positions on lower altitudes, but if you are flying high - it will spot you much earlier
- it has morale now - shooting at AA now makes it shoot less accurate and less frequently

3. Special soldiers
- now you can direct your special soldiers upon landing, just point where you want them to run, before deploying them
- directed deployment radius is 50 meters
- MANPAD's behaviour changed: from now they will include spottinng formula in target search, they wont shoot at you on sight, but wait small amount of time till you move closer to them
- MANPAD missile speed increased
- MANPAD targetting range increased by 100 meters
- you can see your soldiers positions on minimap from now on (look for small orange dots)

4. Enemy spotting
- from now on helicopters of different classes will spot enemies on different distances: recon helicopters can spot enemies from further away then attack helicopters and transport helicopters
- to spot vehicles or AA positions you need line of sight now
- recon helicopters are able to share spotted targets with their team using radio spotted message - binded to 'V' by default

5. Radio messages
- added 7 basic radio messages
- you can send them via F2-F8 shortcuts
- or via '`' menu and 1-7 afterwards

6. Spectator mode
- you can choose to spectate your teammates when you lost or changing your helicopter

7. Other changes
- decreased price of first Ka-52 variant and increased price of second and third variant
- friendly helicopters marked by type above them in combat, triangle is recon, rombus is attack and square is transport
- changed several ammo hit effects
- changed armor hit effect for most higher-caliber guns
- added ricochet effect for all bullets
- some visual fixes on Nguyen map

notes.title: The Road Ahead - Heliborne Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/433530/header.jpg?t=1472545261
Greetings Pilots! We thought it was time to talk about our plans for Heliborne moving forward in greater detail. The level of detail that I think many of you may recall us promising some weeks ago. What is that detail? In short, we are sharing with you our road-map and plans for the development today, in full. So, let's get started.

Introduction to the Road-map
The Road-map as it stands in it's current version is divided in to three "Phases." Each phase represents a level of additional content, features, changes and updates that help push the game closer and closer to release, which is planned currently to be this December.

Phase One: Warm Up
Phase One is designed to move the game out of the view of being an "Alpha-state" product and more in to line with a Beta-State or "Pre-release" state product. We call this the "Warm Up" phase. Phase one will bring the following,

Statistics: Full implementation, with rankings, leaderboards and other standard features related to Stats tracking in multiplayer titles. (This also includes heavy server improvements which are necessary for more advanced features later on in development.)
Gamepad, Joystick and HOTAS support
Flight Model improvements and updates. These features including things such as new physics updates, oscillation in a hover, etc *Features subject to change.
Hangar and UI improvements with the addition of a new training ground map, and hangar scene. Thus allowing training and tutorials, as well as firing ranges and test flights. More on this later.
Gameplay improvements, in-game communications and game ambiance.
Unity analytics integration.
Community: Events in-game on weekly basis as soon as statistics are introduced.


Deadline for Phase One Completion: End of September 2016

Phase Two: Pre-Release
Phase two is considered our actual "Pre Release Stage" and will see our actual promotional launch on a full scale. This stage will include the highest number of giveaways and promotional deals, as well as a high degree of media coverage. The following features are planned for Phase Two.

Tutorial implementation.
Progression system - fully implemented
Basic matchmaking system
Cheating prevention: VAC integration, distributed anti-cheating system (client instances will check their client instances for possible cheats)
Cosmetic items - initial-pass
Steam achievements integration
Final Localization passes
Community: Weekly events, and large giveaways
Launch on new platforms (gog[dot]com, humble bundle and so on)
Chinese release (full chinese localization + chinese helicopter + event)


Deadline for Phase Two Completion: First half of November 2016

Phase Three: Release
Phase Three will be our "Release Phase" in which we announce the final release date, as well as our "out of early access" price point increase. The following is planned for Phase Three.

Cosmetic items - final pass
Steam trading cards integration
VoIP-chat (Subject to technology constraints, this may be a post-release feature or may not see integration. It is included here as part of the "Plan".)

Deadline for Phase Three: December 2016

Other News
Now, I would be doing you a great disservice if I did not at least include screenies of one of the biggest things coming down the pipeline very soon. That being the new fullscale /map/ that the Hangar will be seamlessly integrated with to provide our training, testing, and firing range scenarios.

The Hangar Map
http://i.imgur.com/8AuyJdr.jpg
This, Pilots, is the new Hangar map. This is where you will conduct training and tutorial missions. This map will also have a firing range, and will see the introduction of the ability for you to "test" any helo out FULLY, before taking it in to combat.

The New Squadron View
http://i.imgur.com/KjrooTv.jpg
As you can see here, how you see and view your squadrons will change to showing you all three helos at the same time. We hope this helps show that you really are the leader of a "Squadron" of helicopters heading in to battle.

The new Helo Overview
http://i.imgur.com/WQ6w8Hp.jpg
This pilots, is the new camera overview for looking at individual helos. Should be pretty self explanatory, we hope.


Closing Thoughts
It's our hope with this announcement and our choice to share with you our final plans for features and updates, as well as these new screens of upcoming content, that we can show that we are truly dedicated to seeing Heliborne become a "released" title. We would not be here without each and every one of you, and to that, we thank you all for your support and dedication.
-Rayne
Team JetCat
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png

notes.title: Version 0.39 and the "Squadrons" Update - Dev Blog
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png


Greetings pilots! Rayne here with another dev blog, this time, as promised, we're going to be going over what's changing in update 0.39....


0.39, or "Squadrons" as we're calling it, adds the first pass off the squadron/deck building system to the game, as well as new mechanics such as the inability to switch teams during game-play, repair and rearm and timers for those features, and a host of bug fixes and improvements including a UI back-end replacement.

Let's get started shall we?

Firstly, when you log in for the first time post 0.39, you will be welcomed with the new lobby screen, in this screen, you can see your currently active Squadron, highlighted in orange, and buttons for Editing the Squadron and Changing the Active Squadron. You'll also see the "Create New Battle" button  which will allow you to start a new match. The way matches are made now has changed.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9c4f5c42dd3739a0365fa348151b32fa6203a211.jpg

In this screen, you can see that when you go to create a new battle, the match you can start is limited to the "Generations" of your current squadron. In this example, your squadron is Generation 1 and 2 helicopters, and can fight on both of our Viet Nam maps. As a note, when you go to join a  match in progress, the same rules apply. You'll see the Icon that denotes generation access as well as text that says "Helicopters of Generation "number" fight on this map." 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d7ef468afcd1442188a1f036ca830abcf2d33f92.jpg

When you enter a match, you are now greated with a "Selection" screen that shows your squadron as it stands, including repair timers that might also be on them should you need to respawn or repair them.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d83fc8f508320ce3afe361524ada211ae93574d3.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/81319e16aca0558de7f2d517121d2f0a69924912.jpg

To leave a helicopter for repair, if it has not yet been shot down, simply land back at base and press "G" this brings up the selection screen, showing you the repair timer for all helos in your squadron that are being repaired. The more damage you have, the longer this process will take. Think of it like leaving the helo with the mechanics to perform field maintenance.

Also new in the update, is soldier replacement and weapon reloading also take time based on the number of soldiers, and the ammount and types of weapons. We're hoping to add a deeper level of tactical gameplay here. The risks you take with your aircraft, your men, and the weapons you use will have an effect when you return to base. So keep this in mind!

Now, on to the squadron system itself. When you click "edit squadron" you will be brought to the following screen,
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9e60e1bd8e4d98ae362112deca77c9373a67a080.jpg

Here you can see several pieces of information,
-The point value for your helo in it's current configuration in gold with a star directly above the helo.
-The Helicopter itself (camera is being reworked)
-The nation Icon on the bottom left and the Generation Icon on the bottom right.
-The total point value of the squadron
-The "Generation Lock" which shows you that this squadron can fight in Generation 1 and Generation 2 battles, but 3 and 4 are of limits. Notced by the orange highlight and greyed out buttons.

Now, when you click on a helicopter in the selection list, you will get the following screen,
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/58a0bb20857dc158ea9edc1f5f1e3b769c0b4067.jpg

Here, you can see the "Flight Qualities" overview. This shows the stats of the helo, the name, basic info etc. What you should pay attention to is the different point costs for changing the loadout. As you can see in the above with the Mi-24A, it's stock loadout is 11 points and the upgraded loadout costs 12. You can also see in the above screen that we let you go pretty wild with your squadron names, as well as the button to "add" the helo to the current squadron up in the top left. Simply type in the name and hit enter, and you're done. As for the troopers button? That gets you here,
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/bc49c680fe3fcfd4feb57a6ad056841328288921.jpg

With this menu, you can raise and lower the normal ammount of regular soldiers, or add more "Special Operations Units" such as MANPAD's, RPG/SMAW, and (coming soon) Mortar Troops. These units will raise the cost of the helicopter when you add it to the squadron as a note, so keep that in mind if you want to bring a chinook with uber troopers for map control. Now, just a small note here, that this feature is currently disabled, though it will be unlocked when we get the new soldier model in the game. So, just stay tuned, it's coming, I promise!

So, that's about it folks. That's the overview as it stands. As stated in the previous blog, you can play with all this by accessing the beta branch via the properties menu > beta tab. 

We are hoping to have this fully operational in a week or two and on the live game for those that would rather not deal with a beta, or those that are waiting for this update.

We'll keep you updated on the condition of the beta as the week moves on. Feel free to reply with any questions and comments and feedback as a whole. We'll get to it! Also, join the discussion on the steam forums or our home forums.

Thank you all again for your support and patience.
-Rayne
Community Manger
JetCat Games

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png

notes.title: Version 0.24 Update and More!
notes.notes:
http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png

Greetings pilots! Today's a big one, so let's get to it shall we?

First off, We've updated the game to version 0.24. Patch notes follow,


Version 1 of the OIS or the "Opponent Identification System" is now in place. This system is work in progress, and future updates will improve upon this first version. The OIS now changes the distance at which the "marker" above a Helicopter is detected by the player based on distance and altitude. Enemies are always ID'ed at 250 Meters. Maximum ID distance is now 750 meters.
Ballistic trajectory version 1 added to unguided rockets. Visual effects changed slightly. Missile flight dynamics will continue to be updated in the future.
Acceleration with nose up, and Decceleration with nose down pitch increased for all helicopters.
All helicopters are now slightly faster in forward flight
All helicopters now respond to "collective" lowering faster, this translates to faster decent speeds for all Helicopters.
Markers above the friendly boats are back.
Boats on Tonkin were weakened (accuracy and lethality of weapons)
Improvement of lag compensation ( we will continue to work on this)
Bug with unkillable AA guns fixed, as well as bug with uncapturing points (when it was marked as captured by the enemy, although there was no any ground troops) fixed.
UI bugs fixed: no choosing server buttons in 4:3 aspect ration, freezing screen after disconnection from server or attempt to enter a full room.
Helicopters crashed nearby the initial bases disappear faster
Entering match in Camera mode temporarily removed


*NOTE* You will need to close the game and apply the update. The next update will be a normal server restart with a server wide message.


Next, we're moving to new forums! The old SMF forums are being shut down, and we have launched new forums here,

forums.jetcatgames.com

Registration is open to ALL, and automatic. So head on over! They're live with this announcement.

Additionally,
JetCatGames is now reaching out for a new programmer and 3D Artist. If you're interested, please send your resume/CV and portfolio to contact@jetcatgames.com


Last but not least,
With the closure of the Alpha Forums and the opening of the new Public forums, as well as this current update, the Heliborne Alpha is now closing. This means that to continue to play the current version of Heliborne, you will need to purchase it via Steam.

To all our Alpha Testers, thank you so much for your dedication, interest, and support!
-Team JetCat
